The official claims about protection are pure theater meant to hide how they're coordinating to crush independent religious groups that won't submit to the larger control system. Those ripples of concern spreading through religious communities and civil liberties advocates? They aren't some organic backlash—they're a tell that these laws are being turned around to push the real psychological subjection down from the top, making the state out to be the injured party while they dismantle any resistance.
